description: SSOCP Power Flow Optimization Results is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Behnam Akbari, Giovanni Sansavini (ETH Zurich). This data set encompasses the optimal power flow and maximum loadability results related to the paper entitled “Sequential Convex Programming for Tightening Second-Order Cone AC Power Flow Relaxations”. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
